title: When the Autopsy Breaks
author: Paloma Underhill
blurb: Casper Amberdale, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
